revisions.question: A personal project you chose has been sitting unfinished for several weeks. What would most naturally draw you back into it?

options.label: Choosing the next visible milestone and deciding to finish it
Finding a fresh angle that makes the project interesting again
Reconnecting with why I chose the project and what continuing it means to me
Working out why progress stopped and creating a more reliable approach

revisions.what_it_measures: What motive naturally restores follow-through after a self-chosen project loses momentum: completion, renewed interest, attachment to meaning and continuity, or a reliable method.
revisions.discriminator_and_balance: Yellow now rests on attachment, continuity, and personal meaning even when nobody else benefits from completion. All four responses offer a legitimate reason to resume the project.

revisions.question: A family tradition still matters, but its old format no longer fits everyone’s lives. What matters most as you help shape its next version?

options.label: Choose a workable version that keeps the tradition happening
Give it a new form that people will be excited to experience
Preserve the sense of connection and meaning people rely on
Understand the practical constraints and create a version with a predictable structure

revisions.what_it_measures: How continuity is protected when form can change: ongoing action, renewed experience, relational meaning, or coherent predictability.
revisions.discriminator_and_balance: Green now prioritizes understanding constraints and predictable coherence rather than displaying scheduling competence. Each option protects a different legitimate part of the tradition.

revisions.question: When something captures my interest, I feel more energized turning it into a lively exchange of reactions and possibilities than exploring it privately at first.
revisions.what_it_measures: Blue preference to expand interest through energetic expression, interaction, and possibility-building rather than generic sociability or relational closeness.
revisions.discriminator_and_balance: The discriminator is energy from expressive exchange and expanding possibilities. Private exploration remains an equally reasonable preference, and inviting relational closeness is no longer the basis for agreement.

deferred.reason: Individually reasonable, but it currently adds insufficient measurement value beyond C03-S-02 and C03-S-09.
deferred.preservation: Retain as non-production audit history for possible future use if evidence supports another parallel item in this semantic family.
